purpose: Deterministic validation for imported ChatGPT deep-research opening lines before using them in the local trainer.

sources.name: Lichess chess-openings root TSV files a.tsv-e.tsv
sources.license: CC0-1.0/public domain facts as stated by upstream README

notes: legalSan=true means chess.js accepted every SAN move in strict mode.
pgn-exact means the imported full PGN exactly matches a Lichess chess-openings line.
lichess-prefix means the imported line continues a known Lichess chess-openings PGN prefix; the extra plies are treated as app research, not a separate Lichess opening-name assertion.
